summary: App that generates a company logo from a user-provided description and displays an animated version of the logo.
imageRequirements:
## Required Images
- Abstract creative-tool background pattern, subtle grid with soft shapes (app-bg.dim_1920x1080.png)
- Minimal monochrome app icon featuring a geometric mark (app-icon.dim_512x512.png)

existing_features.title: Create a single-page UI where a user can enter a company logo description (free-text) and trigger logo generation, showing loading/error states and the resulting static logo preview.

Implement a deterministic, offline logo-design generator that converts the user-provided description into a structured logo specification and renders a clean vector logo (SVG) from it (no external AI/LLM or third-party APIs).

Show an animated version of the generated logo, with user controls to play/pause and adjust animation speed; the animation should be derived from the same logo specification and remain visually consistent with the static logo.
Persist generated logo projects per signed-in user: store the description, generated logo specification, and timestamps; provide a list to reopen previously generated logos.
Add export options to download the generated logo as SVG and a raster image (PNG) from the frontend.
Apply a cohesive visual theme for the app UI (colors, typography, layout) with a distinct style suitable for a creative design tool, and use it consistently across all screens and states.

new_feature_requests.summary: Generate a logo design based on a user-provided company description
Display an animated version of the generated logo
